sqlMap.update: UPDATE IF_PODT SET IF_FLAG = 'N', STATUS = 'D' WHERE BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#),' ') AND LEGACY_PO_NO = NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_NO#),' ') AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_SEQ#),' ') AND REVISION = NVL(TRIM(#REVISION#) ,' ')
sqlMap.select: SELECT NVL(AGENT, ' ') AS AGENT, NVL(CONTRACT_NO, ' ') AS CONTRACT_NO, NVL(CONTRACT_SEQ,' ') AS CONTRACT_SEQ FROM IF_PODT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= #LEGACY_PO_SEQ#

SELECT NVL(USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(DEPARTMENT,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_DEPT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#),' ') AND LEGACY_USER_ID = NVL(TRIM(#PURCHASER_USER_ID#),' ') AND STATUS != 'D'
